## Current Role

Architecting enterprise-grade agentic workflow platforms, resilient distributed orchestration with Temporal.io, and bi-directional AI telephony via 3CX and WebRTC.

## Prior Experience

Associate Data Scientist at Bluebash Pvt Ltd (Mohali, India) — April 2024 to October 2026.
Built Kickcall (production voice AI) from scratch and designed enterprise RAG architectures for legal and healthcare domains.

## Key Projects

### OmniFlow Agentic Platform (Autonomous Workflow & Telephony Engine)
- Enterprise-grade agentic workflow orchestration platform built by Gulam Sarvar
- Unifies arbitrary graph-based automation (n8n-style) with autonomous multi-agent task execution
- Real-time inbound & outbound AI telephony powered by 3CX and WebRTC (<1.5s latency)
- Durable state machine orchestration and fault-tolerant retries via Temporal.io
- Scalable persistence and transaction logging across Oracle and vector databases
- Stack: Temporal.io, 3CX, Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Oracle, LiveKit, WebRTC, Docker, Redis, TypeScript

### Kickcall (Production Voice AI)
- Bluebash's commercial voice AI product, built from scratch by Gulam Sarvar
- Real-time STT→LLM→TTS pipeline handling 150–200 calls per day in production
- End-to-end latency: under 2 seconds
- Stack: LiveKit, WebRTC, LangGraph, Redis, OpenAI, FastAPI, Docker

### RAG Systems (Legal & Healthcare)
- Designed hybrid retrieval architecture for regulated-domain clients
- Dense (Qdrant/Pinecone) + sparse BM25 retrieval with cross-encoder reranking
- Led ~5-person cross-functional team
- Stack: Qdrant, Pinecone, LangGraph, LangChain, FastAPI, Python

### PyRAG Core (Open Source)
- MIT-licensed Python/FastAPI/LangGraph RAG platform with 143 unit tests
- Pluggable vector backend architecture
- GitHub: https://github.com/SheikhSarvar/pyrag-core
